title: Record Equality Backward State
statement: For each Boolean $b$ and each $j\in\{0,\ldots,k+2\}$, define a dependent control state as follows: if $j>0$, its index is the backward index carrying $b$, $j-1$, and $0$, and its phase is the running seek phase; if $j=0$, its index is the verdict index carrying $b$, again with the running seek phase.
